items.exampleEn: We take a taxi to the airport.
Our vacation is very short this year.
I see an airplane in the sky.
items.exampleZh: 我看到天上有一架飛機。

items.exampleEn: I ride my bicycle to school.
I take the subway to work.
Is this the way to the station?
My father has a red car.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸有一台紅色的車。

items.sentenceEn: A jet is flying over our house.
items.sentenceZh: 一架噴射機正飛過我們家上空。

items.audioEn: My car is broken, so I will ride my bicycle today.
items.audioZh: 我的車壞了，所以今天騎腳踏車。

items.sentenceEn: We go on vacation by car.
This is the fastest way to school.

items.stemEn: Excuse me, can you tell me the ____ to the bank?
items.stemZh: 不好意思，可以告訴我去銀行的路嗎？

items.stemEn: We are going to the beach for our summer ____.

items.passageEn: This summer, the Lins are going on vacation to Japan. They will take a taxi to the airport early in the morning. The airplane leaves at nine. In Tokyo, they will take the subway and ride bicycles around the city.
items.passageZh: 今年夏天，林家要去日本度假。他們一大早會搭計程車去機場，飛機九點起飛。在東京，他們會搭地鐵，也會騎腳踏車逛城市。

questions.questionZh: 在東京他們要怎麼移動？

referenceEn: I take the subway to work every day.
I go to work by subway every day.
rubricZh: 「搭捷運」可用 take the subway、by subway、by MRT 等
「上班」可用 go to work、to work
every day 放句首或句尾都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 vacation 造一個句子，說說你想去或去過哪裡度假。
referenceEn: I want to go to Japan on vacation.
I went to the beach on my vacation.
rubricZh: 「去度假」可用 go on vacation、on vacation 等
時態配合內容（例如想做的事用 want to；過去的事用過去式）
